The Caribbean Sanctuary

A private residence sculpted around light and water.

The Love Shack is an architectural five-bedroom beachfront estate positioned on Aruba's tranquil southern coast. Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, trade winds sweep through double-height living spaces directly to the azure waters of Baby Beach.

Mornings begin with espresso on the sea-facing terrace and refreshing laps in the freshwater infinity pool; afternoons unfold in secluded shade with paddleboards and kayaks at your doorstep; evenings gather ten around an open-air teak dining table beneath the Caribbean stars.

The Arrival

A shaded stone entrance lined with swaying palms and bougainvillea. As the antique wooden doors swing open, cool travertine stone lies underfoot and the turquoise Caribbean sea greets you straight through the open pavilion.

02 / 07

Living & Dining

Double-height vaulted ceilings and expansive glass doors that tuck completely into walls. Furnished with Italian linen sofas, custom reclaimed teak furniture, and trade winds that maintain natural coolness from morning to dusk.

03 / 07

Five Private Bedrooms

Each bedroom is an individual sanctuary designed for deep rest. Dressed in crisp organic Belgian linen, premium hypoallergenic mattresses, private climate control, and en-suite stone bathrooms opening toward ocean light.

04 / 07

Chef's Gourmet Kitchen

A polished Carrera marble island with bar seating, professional 6-burner gas range, dual refrigeration, automated espresso station, and handcrafted dinnerware ready for large family feasts or private chef tastings.

05 / 07

Freshwater Pool & Deck

An azure freshwater swimming pool flanked by submerged tanning shelves, plush sun loungers, and an outdoor shower carved from natural coral stone. Heated by the Caribbean sun all year round.

06 / 07

Outdoor Living & Pergola

A shaded outdoor dining pavilion featuring a solid teak banquet table for ten, outdoor gas grill, ambient hurricane lanterns, and open ocean panoramas where sunset skies turn from amber to violet.

07 / 07

Beach Path & Shoreline

Follow a private natural stone path meandering through sea-grape trees directly onto Baby Beach. Ocean kayaks, stand-up paddleboards, and private snorkeling gear await for spontaneous reef exploration.

The Neighborhood

Seroe Colorado, Baby Beach

The Love Shack is nestled in the exclusive and serene enclave of Seroe Colorado at the southern tip of Aruba. Far away from high-rise hotel crowds, here you experience the authentic Caribbean: tranquil lagoons, sea breezes, dramatic coastal bluffs, and crystal-clear swimming beaches.

Baby Beach (Calm waters & snorkeling) 3 min walk
Rodger's Beach (Pristine quiet sand) 2 min walk

Clear Expectations

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the exact check-in and check-out times?

Standard check-in is at 4:00 PM and check-out is at 10:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out can be requested depending on preceding guest departures and can be coordinated directly with host Alexandra.

What is the maximum guest occupancy and bedroom layout?

The Love Shack accommodates a maximum of 10 guests across 5 en-suite bedrooms (two King bedrooms, two Queen bedrooms, and one bedroom with two twin beds that can convert to King). All suites have air conditioning and private bathrooms.

What is your pet policy?

Well-behaved pets are welcome with prior host approval (maximum of 2 pets per stay). A one-time pet sanitation fee of $75 applies to ensure the villa remains immaculate for all guests.

What is the minimum stay requirement?

To preserve the tranquil atmosphere of the property, a minimum stay of 3 nights is required throughout the year. Stays of 7 nights or longer automatically receive a 10% weekly discount.

Is there a refundable security deposit?

Yes. A $500 refundable security deposit is held on your card prior to arrival and released within 48 hours following checkout inspection.

Is parking available on site?

Yes, the villa features secure, gated private parking inside the estate compound accommodating up to four vehicles free of charge.

What is the cancellation policy?

Full refund for cancellations made within 48 hours of booking if the check-in date is at least 14 days away. 50% refund for cancellations made at least 30 days before check-in. Custom cancellation arrangements can be discussed with Alexandra.

Architectural Spaces

Villa Features & Living Spaces

Explore every corner of The Love Shack—from the five en-suite king suites to the al fresco dining terrace and infinity pool.

Indoor Living

Double-Height Living Lounge

The central pavilion acts as the vibrant heart of the villa. Vaulted exposed-beam ceilings create soaring air volume, while folding glass accordion doors collapse entirely to blend living spaces with the oceanfront terrace.

Furnished with oversized Italian linen sofas, custom artisan teak coffee tables, 65" 4K Smart TV with international streaming, and a high-fidelity Sonos sound system.

Culinary Gathering

The Gourmet Chef's Kitchen

Whether preparing a fresh catch or hosting a private chef dinner, the kitchen is fully equipped for culinary excellence. A sweeping Carrera marble island seats six, anchored by a commercial 6-burner gas range with griddle.

Includes dual dishwashers, French door refrigeration, Jura espresso machine, temperature-controlled wine cooler, and full dinnerware for twelve.

Direct Shoreline

Private Baby Beach Access

Unlike resorts where beach chairs must be claimed at dawn, your private natural coral path leads directly from the garden gate to the powder-soft sand of Baby Beach.

Enjoy complimentary use of ocean tandem kayaks, stand-up paddleboards, snorkeling masks, fins, and lightweight beach loungers.
